sections.name: Path to Glory
sections.text: Here, you will find additional rules to use wit h a Gloomspite Gitz army while playing through a Path to Glory campaign. These rules are divided into two parts: the Anvil of Apotheosis and Paths for Gloomspite Gitz units.

sections.name: The Anvil of Apotheosis
sections.text:
You can have 1 Anvil of Apotheosis hero on your Order of Battle and/or army roster, unless otherwise specified in the battlepack you are using. They can be your warlord. There are 7 steps to follow to create your hero:
1. Pick a boss.
2. Set a destiny point limit.
3. Fill out the starting warscroll.
4. Pick your hero’s origin and/or flaw.
5. Choose a Battle Mount.
6. Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades.
7. Pick any other upgrades.

sections.name: Grot
sections.text:
Your hero gains the following regiment options:
Regiment Options
Any MOONCLAN, SQUIG, SPIDERFANG or GITMOB units

sections.name: Troggoth
sections.text:
Your hero gains the following regiment options:
Regiment Options
Any TROGGOTH units

sections.name: Step 2 - Set a Destiny Point Limit
sections.text:
The Anvil of Apotheosis uses a currency called destiny points. First, you need to set a destiny point limit. This will determine how many destiny points you have to spend on your hero, what type of hero they will be and what their battle profile points cost will be. Pick l of the following:
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
Grot Boss | 10 | 100
Grot Mob Boss | 30 | 200
Grot Big Mob Boss | 50 | 320
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
Troggoth Boss | 10 | 150
Troggoth Mob Boss | 30 | 250
Troggoth Big Mob Boss | 50 | 350
Over the next few steps, you will pick options for your hero. Each option has a destiny point cost, abbreviated as DP. Keep a record of the number of destiny points you have spent. You cannot exceed the limit you have set.

sections.name: Step 4 - Pick Your Hero's Origin And/Or Flaw
sections.text:
You can pick up lo I origin and up to l flaw for your hero. Each adds an ability to your hero's warscroll.
However, instead of costing destiny points, llaws give you extra destiny points to spend elsewhere.

sections.name: Step 5 - Choose a Battle Mount
sections.text:
If your hero does not have the TROGGOTH keyword, you can pick up to 1 Battle Mount for them. If you choose not to have a battle mount for your non-TROGGOTH hero, you can add 1 of the following keywords to their warscroll: MOONCLAN, SPIDERFANG or GITMOB.
Battle Mount
-5DP
SNARLFANG: The large lupines known as Snarlfangs are extremely swift and just as spiteful as their riders. Like the grots, others of their kind usually fall into line behind the strongest and meanest specimens.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Snarlfang's Slavering Jaws
Companion | 3 | 3+ | 3+ | - | 2
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 12".
Change the Health characteristic to 6.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the CAVALRY keyword.
Add the GITMOB keyword.

-8DP

sections.name: Path of The Gitboss
sections.text:
(GLOOMSPITE GITZ HERO only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
TOUGH GIT
Effect: Add 1 to this unit's Health characteristic.
Passive
EXTRA STABBY
Effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits).
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
FROTHING ENTHUSIASM
Effect: If this unit charged this turn, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
Passive
SCALE-SPLITTER
Effect: This unit cannot be picked to be the target of RAMPAGE abilities used by enemy units.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
ALMOST BLESSED BY THE BAD MOON
Effect: This unit has WARD (3+). After the first failed ward roll made for it, however, it has WARD (6+) instead.
End of Any Turn
SADISTIK SCOUNDREL
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn to be the targets.
Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
THE ANGRIEST GIT AROUND
Effect: Add 3 to the control scores of all friendly units while this unit is contesting an objective.
Any Combat Phase
SNEAKY SIDESTEPPER
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the target’s weapons and subtract 3 from its Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.
